SELECT p.id AS performanceId, p.concert_id AS concertId, p.venue_hall_id AS venueHallId,
v.name AS venueName, vh.name AS venueHallName,
p.starts_at AS startsAt, p.ends_at AS endsAt,
p.reservation_opens_at AS reservationOpensAt, p.reservation_closes_at AS reservationClosesAt,
p.max_tickets_per_member AS maxTicketsPerMember,
p.status AS status
FROM v1_performances p
INNER JOIN v1_venue_halls vh ON vh.id = p.venue_hall_id
INNER JOIN v1_venues v ON v.id = vh.venue_id
ORDER BY p.starts_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}
